# %site.brand.full%

> An open record of power outages for homes supplied by the Garsfontein substation in Pretoria, South Africa, kept since %since.en% (%site.timeZone%). There is no data from before that date. Independent service, operated by a Garsfontein resident. Not affiliated with the City of Tshwane or Eskom.

Area: measured in %site.area.name%, in %site.area.region%. Supplied by the Garsfontein substation (fed from Highlands, which is fed from Njala).

The record covers all power outages, planned and unplanned, whatever the cause. It is not a load-shedding schedule.

Site: %site.url%/
The site is in Afrikaans by default, with an option to switch to English. The API and this file are in English.
Source code (MIT): %site.repo%

## Endpoints

All public endpoints are free to use and allow any origin (CORS). They share a limit of 60 requests a minute per connection, with IPv6 addresses counted per /64. Please poll no more than once every 30 seconds.

- [Live status (JSON)](%site.url%/api/status)
- [Statistics (JSON)](%site.url%/api/stats): for the last 7, 30 and 365 days, hours without power, number of outages (and how many were planned), days with an outage, share of time with power, and the longest outage; the previous 30 days for comparison; and weekly totals. Only time since records began is counted.
- [All outages (CSV)](%site.url%/api/outages.csv): one row per outage, with id, start and end (UTC), duration in minutes, whether it was planned, and the number of community confirmations. Outages marked as false positives are excluded.
- [Sitemap](%site.url%/sitemap.xml)
- [Privacy notice](%site.url%/privacy)

## /api/status fields

- `status`: `"ON"` or `"OFF"`
- `since`: when the current state began (ISO 8601), or null
- `outage`: the outage in progress (`id`, `startTime`, `endTime`, `planned`, `confirmations`), or null
- `recent`: the five most recent outages, newest first
- `generatedAt`: server time of the response

All times are UTC. Local time is %site.timeZone% (SAST, UTC+2, no daylight saving).

`planned` is true for outages announced in advance (for example maintenance or upgrades). Planned outages still count as time without power.

`confirmations` is the number of community confirmations: residents who reported that their power was also off. At most one per connection per outage, verified with Cloudflare Turnstile.
